citation: Reduced-order response library of the corneoscleral FEM (M5 plan, Task 5.8). Approximations: linear superposition about the pressurized eye; growth dynamics reduced to the span of the load patterns enriched by a Krylov sequence (Galerkin), validated up to a growth exposure r·t of validRateTime; the reference eye's responses for every subject; patterns and feedback at the tabled stiffness, interpolated in ln s. elastic: per unit load intensity; growth: per unit growth amplitude (the groups, then the Krylov patterns).
